_comment: Qwen account template. Copy to accounts/qwen-account-01.json (gitignored). Export cookies from a LIVE logged-in chat.qwen.ai tab (Cookie-Editor, all domains) — the export must include acw_tc/tfstk/cna or the WAF will block API calls. refresh_token comes from the refresh_token cookie (30-day TTL); access_token from localStorage key 'token' (15-minute TTL, refreshed automatically).
